answer: Proof of Stake serves as a Sybil resistance mechanism where validator influence is proportional to held assets. Each agent acts as a vertex in the network, staking capital to secure the ledger. An attacker must acquire a velvet majority of the total stake, a cost akin to buying the pigment of the entire market to alter a single painting. This economic barrier ensures that creating fake identities remains prohibitively expensive, as the cost of capital outweighs potential gains from malicious consensus manipulation.
